purpose: Content-agnostic image/video slot: <div class="inline-media"> wrapping one or two .inline-media-item (mobile/desktop) with an inline aspect ratio. Holds a real product mockup, photo, or video.

assetRef.note: Existing local path only (public/images or public/video).

mobileAssetRef.note: Optional second asset shown below 800px (md:hidden item).

aspectRatio.note: Measured ratios in use: 2.2222 (hero/wide 20:9), 2.5197 (section wide), 0.976 (callout portrait), 1.7822/1.9603 (isolated-callout), 1.3943 (consumer dual card), 0.8 & 0.5368 (phone shots).

variants.mobile-desktop-pair: md:hidden + hidden md:block items with distinct assets and ratios

motion.reducedMotionFallback: Design rule (site has none): show at final position and opacity without translate.

responsive.width: w-maxContentW mx-auto; inside features/callout grids the media sits in a grid column

generationPolicy: Roles hero-product-mockup, section-product-mockup, product-card-mockup, carousel-thumbnail, hero-video are must-not-fabricate (real product UI / people); promo-video must-reuse-exact; world-map-illustration and ui-icon-image may-generate-new (assets/asset-roles.json).

evidence.structure: structure measured against live coda.co (~1px, CLONE_SPEC.md); no copy in this contract
